Papa is a bit of a slow burn when it comes to affection. He just needs a little time to feel safe and let his guard down. With a few gentle head pets and some tasty Churus, you'll soon find him head butting your hand and asking for more love and attention!
Papa's dream furever home is a peaceful one where he can have his alone time and his boundaries respected. In return, he'll be happy to share moments of play, affection, and cuddles once he's ready.
If you believe the best relationships are built on patience, trust, and love, Papa might just be your perfect match! ðŸ¯ðŸ’•

Meet handsome cuddly Papa. This little tiger is shy at first, but naturally curious and a master at head bumps asking for pets and cheek scratches. Papa has blossomed into a playful cat who likes chase after his poof balls and show you his deep stretches. If you are looking for a lap cat who loves a nightly snuggle Papa is your perfect match. Every time we climb onto our couch, Papa follows shortly after climbing on and nuzzling his head closer to ours. Even after pets, he'll stay and sometimes fall asleep. Papa is ready to be loved and find his furever home!

My foster writes: With his adorable ginger face in a state of perpetual concern, Papa thinks things through before giving you his love. But, after a few days, when he's decided to commit (and you take off those scary boots!), he's all in - sleeping beside you at night and climbing up your lap to position his furry orange feet right on your shoulders. A very sweet boy!
dog.name: Papa
